description: Immutable cumulative player-leader snapshots, isolated from odds, results, and team-ranking data.

snapshots.methodology: Cumulative individual player yards summed from all 79 verified ESPN regular-season box scores through Week 5; league leaders cross-checked with official NFL tables. No preseason games. Only highest player name/category stored per scope.

unavailable_fields.reason: Official scoring leaderboard returned HTTP 500; complete individual scoring points cannot be verified from a partial leaderboard.

snapshots.methodology: Cumulative individual player yards from all 93 verified final 2026 regular-season game boxes through Week 6. Reused saved ESPN evidence and exact week cutoffs; highest names only per scope.

4432708.review: Attribution verified from individual game team IDs. Conference/division totals include only statistics earned for teams in that scope; league sums all teams. No current-team reassignment of earlier statistics.

unavailable_fields.reason: Official complete scoring leaderboard returned HTTP 500. Do not infer scoring leaders from yards, touchdowns alone or incomplete kicking/two-point records.

conference_position_snapshots.methodology: Cumulative individual game statistics from every final 2026 regular-season ESPN box score through this week. Positions verified against ESPN 2026 rosters; team/conference from the game, not current standings. QB passing yards are gross, before sacks. RB rushing only; WR/TE receiving only. YPC and completion percentage calculated from summed attempts, not averaged game percentages. Five players per position; ties share competition rank, alphabetical order resolves the fifth-player display cutoff. Retrospective statistics capture, not a pregame prediction.

league_position_snapshots.methodology: League-wide cumulative individual game statistics from all verified final 2026 regular-season ESPN boxes through this week. QB gross passing yards; RB rushing yards; WR/TE receiving yards ranked separately. Ties share competition rank; alphabetical order resolves fifth-place display cutoff. Multi-team players are merged by verified player ID across all applicable teams, with team displaying the latest team in this snapshot’s game evidence. Earlier snapshots remain independent. Historical backfill is retrospective statistics, not a pregame forecast.
